title: Cross-team Engineering Staff Meeting — 2026-03-10
content:
Meeting: Cross-team engineering leadership staff sync
Date: 2026-03-10 10:00–11:00 PT (recurring weekly)
Location: Zoom + #eng-leads Slack thread (pinned)
Facilitator: Ava Chen
Attendees: Ava Chen (platform), Diego Martinez (serving-runtime), Sana Kapoor (dedicated), Ethan Park (private deploys), Marta Li (console), Noor Ahmed (SRE - dialed in), Priya Raman (product - joined for 30m)

TL;DR
- Core decisions: greenlight rolling canary for model routing changes (INF-2142) with guardrails; postpone cluster-wide quantization rollout until perf benchmark completes next Tuesday.
- High-risk items: Dedicated capacity billing mismatch affecting a small set of customers (Sana + Billing). Immediate mitigations listed below.
- Action-heavy week: 8 owners assigned across infra, runtime, and console to finish canary, SLO tests, and deploy monitoring hooks.

Agenda
1) Quick round-robin updates (2 min per team)
2) Deep-dive: Model routing changes & canary plan (INF-2142) — Diego
3) Incident follow-up: Dedicated billing mismatch — Sana
4) SRE ask: synthetic SLO load and latency windows — Noor
5) Console integrations: rollout visibility and rollback UX — Marta
6) Open parking lot / blockers / decisions

Round-robin updates (high level)
- Serving runtime (Diego): Kernel selection improvements merged to main (PR 678); microbench shows 5–8% throughput improvement on 32k contexts, but tail latency spike under certain batch sizes (investigating). Preparing canary config for routing.
- Dedicated (Sana): Investigating billing mismatch for three enterprise tenants — discrepancies between reserved capacity metering and runtime reported tokens. Temporary mitigation: throttle new reservations for affected pools; Billing team running reconciliation job.
- Private deploys (Ethan): On-prem package 0.9.4 candidate ready; includes new KMS hooks and simplified network policy. Need one customer pilot to sign off for air-gapped installer UX.
- Console (Marta): Rollout dashboard UI for per-model rollout percentage is ready in staging; needs backend endpoints to report canary metrics and fallback counts.
- SRE (Noor): Synthetic load harness needs a one-time increase in parallel clients to validate autoscaling under high-concurrency small-token requests. Requesting infra quota increase for next Wed stress run.
- Product (Priya): Customer-facing release notes draft ready; requested a short FAQ for canary/regression expectations.

Deep-dive: Model routing changes & canary plan (Diego)
Goal: route requests to model variant A/B by cost tier and latency budget, with automatic fallback to a cheaper model if high queueing detected.
Plan highlights:
- Week 1 (canary): route 2–5% traffic from internal beta customers -> 10% -> 25% over three waves.
- Safety nets: per-tenant circuit breaker, per-route latency SLO guard, automatic model fallback policy if 95p latency > SLO for 10m.
- Observability: need KV cache hit metric, per-route queue depth, and rollback signal in console.
Risks called out:
- KV cache invalidation may temporarily increase token costs during early waves.
- Fallback loops if monitoring misreports queue depth.
Decision: proceed with canary after adding two extra monitoring hooks and smoke tests (see actions).

Incident follow-up: Dedicated billing mismatch (Sana)
Summary: Four invoices flagged by accounts receivable; affected tenants saw usage overreported by 10–12% for Feb 26–Mar 3. Root cause preliminary: double-counting at the sharding proxy when warm-up tokens merged incorrectly with steady-state metrics.
Immediate mitigations:
- Temporary throttling of new reservations for pools created in last 30 days (implemented).
- Billing reconciliation job scheduled—expected completion by EOD Fri.
- Customer comms: CS drafted initial message (Sana + CS).
Open items:
- Confirm root cause with infra logs (INF-2198).
- Retro and permanent fix plan due next Tue.

SRE request: Synthetic SLO load (Noor)
- Need: bump cluster quota for load test Wed 2026-03-17 02:00–06:00 PT.
- Purpose: validate autoscaling policies under high-concurrency, low-token-per-request workloads; capture 50k rps sustained for 20 minutes.
- Action: Ethan + infra to provision temporary nodes and ensure cost bucket assigned.

Console integrations: rollout visibility & rollback UX (Marta)
- Console needs two backend signals from runtime: (1) model-fallback counter per-minute, (2) per-model prefix cache hit rate. These will appear on rollout detail page and drive the rollback button activation.
- UX change: when a rollback is triggered by SLO guard, console should annotate timeline and send an automated slack alert to #incidents and #eng-leads.
- Marta to prepare staging screenshots; ETA Wed 2026-03-12.

Parking lot / blockers / open decisions
- Quantization rollout: postponed until next week's benchmarks. Owner: Diego. Deadline for go/no-go: 2026-03-17.
- SLA page updates for Dedicated (billing edge cases) — legal review pending. Owner: Sana + legal.
- Private deployment air-gapped installer: need a customer sign-off by 2026-03-24 to make GA. Owner: Ethan.

Action items (condensed)
1) Diego: Add KV cache hit metric and per-route queue depth to runtime telemetry; add smoke tests for auto-fallback. Due: 2026-03-12. Linked: PR 678.
2) Marta: Wire console rollback UX to slack alert + staging screenshots. Due: 2026-03-12.
3) Sana: Finish billing reconciliation job and prepare customer comms for impacted tenants. Due: 2026-03-13.
4) Noor + Ethan: Provision nodes and confirm quota bump for Wed stress run. Due: 2026-03-15.
5) Ava: Draft exec summary for CTO and Ops by Fri EOD; include canary checklist and risk matrix. Due: 2026-03-13.
6) Diego + Eng QA: Complete quantization perf benchmarks; report go/no-go. Due: 2026-03-17.
7) Priya: Finalize FAQ for customers about canary/regression behavior. Due: 2026-03-12.

Decisions logged
- Canary allowed with additional telemetry and smoke tests (see action 1).
- Postpone quantization rollout until benchmark completion (see above).

Notes / miscellaneous
- Quick note to infra: consider increasing default per-tenant circuit breaker to avoid noisy neighbor fallout during canaries; discussion thread: #infra-circuit-breaker.
- Found a backlog of stale feature flags in config service — Diego to run a cleanup and add an automated expiry for flags >180 days.
- Suggested topic for next week: cross-team incident response drill (SRE + runtime + console) — proposal to run on 2026-03-24.

Next meeting
- Date: 2026-03-17 10:00 PT
- Proposed deep-dive: Quantization benchmark results + canary first-wave postmortem checklist

Appendix: quick links (copied into chat during meeting)
- INF-2142 (routing & canary): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2142
- Billing issue ticket INF-2198: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2198
- Serving runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/678
- Console rollout mockups (staging): confluence:redwood/platform/rollouts

Notes-to-self / rough TODOs (informal)
- TODO: follow up with Billing on reconciliation job output and ensure refunds are processed if needed.
- TODO: schedule short show-and-tell for canary telemetry with Eng QA next Tue.
- NOTE: keep canary quietly enabled for beta tenants only until 10% traffic threshold is stable.

End of notes
